overviewParagraphs: Long Thanh Golf Resort is one of the most enduring and popular golf venues in Southern Vietnam, serving the Ho Chi Minh City market since 1994. Designed by Ron Fream — the prolific American designer responsible for some of Asia's most creative layouts — the course uses its rolling topography to strong creative effect.

Massive natural and man-made lake hazards define the visual experience at Long Thanh, coming into play on hole after hole in ways that demand genuine commitment to the target line rather than cautious misses in the wrong direction. The routing rewards attacking golf balanced with intelligent course management.

Well maintained and professionally managed, Long Thanh is a staple on the Saigon golf circuit for a reason. For discerning golfers based in Ho Chi Minh City for business or leisure, it represents a reliable, high-quality round just 30 minutes from the city centre.

curatorBriefHtml: Long Thanh Golf Resort is one of Southern Vietnam’s most beloved and enduring 36-hole championship clubs, located in Dong Nai Province roughly 45–50 minutes east of central Ho Chi Minh City. Designed by Ron Fream’s Golfplan studio, the resort offers two distinct 18-hole experiences: the elevated Hill Course — weaving through rolling palms with sweeping river-valley vistas — and the water-laced Lake Course, featuring floodlit holes for twilight and evening play.

Having played Long Thanh personally, its enduring appeal comes down to conditioning and playability. Fairways are carpeted in plush Paspalum/Zoysia, greens roll consistently true, and the Hill Course’s gentle elevation changes offer a refreshing break from Saigon’s otherwise flat delta terrain. It is also one of the best-run clubs in Southern Vietnam for larger 8- to 16-golfer groups needing consecutive tee times and reliable pace of play.

On a Ho Chi Minh City itinerary, AGS routinely pairs Long Thanh with Vietnam Golf & Country Club (VGCC) and The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram — and because Long Thanh sits directly en route between Saigon and Ho Tram, it works brilliantly as an outbound round on transfer day.

scorecard.verdict: Consistently voted among the best golf courses in Southern Vietnam. Ron Fream's 36-hole complex combines scenic lake holes with rolling hill layouts amidst pristine palms and waterfalls.

faqs.q: Should visiting golfers choose the Hill Course or Lake Course at Long Thanh?
faqs.a: For your first visit, choose the Hill Course — its rolling elevation changes, scenic palm corridors, and elevated greens offer the most memorable architectural variety around Ho Chi Minh City. The Lake Course is flatter with more water hazards and offers floodlit evening play.

faqs.q: How far is Long Thanh Golf Resort from District 1, Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Allow 45 to 60 minutes by private touring vehicle from District 1 (central Saigon) via the Ho Chi Minh City–Long Thanh–Dau Giay Expressway, depending on morning commuter traffic.

faqs.q: Can Long Thanh be played on the drive between Ho Chi Minh City and The Bluffs Ho Tram?
faqs.a: Yes — Long Thanh sits right along the highway corridor heading east toward Ho Tram. Playing a morning round at Long Thanh before continuing 90 minutes to Ho Tram is one of our smoothest Southern Vietnam routing tricks.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Long Thanh Golf Resort?
faqs.a: December through April is Southern Vietnam’s dry season with reliable sunshine and low humidity. From May through November, morning tee times (07:00–08:30 AM) almost always finish well ahead of brief late-afternoon tropical showers.
